name: Teensy 4.1
description: 600 MHz Cortex-M7 module with 8 MB flash, 10/100 Ethernet PHY, microSD socket, USB host header, 3 CAN and 55 I/O, with PSRAM/flash footprints for expansion.
notes: 42 of the 55 I/O pins are on the breadboard headers; the rest are underside pads. Headers are not pre-soldered.
Ethernet needs a 5-pin header to a magjack/RJ45 breakout (PHY is on board); a version without the Ethernet chip (TEENSY41_NE) is cheaper; lockable versions exist for secure boot.
Two unpopulated footprints on the underside for PSRAM and/or extra QSPI flash chips (solder your own); USB host on a 5-pin header.
3.3 V I/O only (not 5 V tolerant); programmed via Teensyduino/HalfKay; SparkFun now manufactures PJRC's boards.
